annotations.text:
COMMENTS · The thread

The thread lives in a BOTTOM SHEET over the post (ruled 2026-08-28), near full height with a sliver of the post above; replies collapse behind counts, deeper answers flatten to @handles at one indent, the entry row is pinned at the sheet's foot. Comment media is words-first (media slice, 2026-08-31): pictures sit below the words, inset at the card's medium rung, never cropped — a single picture at its own ratio, multiples in the pager on a fixed square frame, four max. The viewer's OWN comment wears Edit and — once edited — the same Edited marker posts wear. EDITING A COMMENT is the post's one-screen-one-batch at comment scale (words, pictures + the describe counter, topics, citations; license locked); its acts footer ('This creates n signed actions') opens the ACTS SHEET — the EditActs pattern rendered with ActsCard: the sheet title carries the count, the card the rows and the all-or-nothing note. A COMMENT'S VIDEO PLAYS LIKE A POST'S (jakob 2026-09-02): muted autoplay while it is on screen, in the pager's square frame, wearing the one control a video ever wears — sound, on the sticky global decision every video shares. No play/pause and no duration pill on a reading surface: presence on screen is the policy at both scales. Boards: the thread · a video, pictures & own comment · Edit comment · Edit comment's acts.

SEARCH — the Explore tab (item 9, rulings in readme §13 / Q46). At rest: the field, the orbit hero (item 16’s future 3D view), device-local recents. Searching: the worded filter trigger + the one “?”, ranked rows wearing the graph glyph, the seam, the aged tail. Scope operators @handle / #topic; indirect hits say their target on the second line.

FEED · The filter (item 19, growing item 4). The trigger sits on the CograBand's right edge — the band never spends its full width on identity alone — and scrolls away and back with it. EVERY feed view wears it, guests and applicants too: filtering is a read control. The trigger speaks deviations only ('Posts' at rest; 'Posts · photos · newest' when flipped; past the pill's budget the extras collapse to a count — '3 kinds · 4 changes', the far-from-default board). The sheet: ten kinds that combine — ONE list shared with search, 'Profiles' everywhere — forms of post, the Order section (Ranked/Newest + 'Show what you've already seen', DEFAULT OFF: what you've seen stays out until asked back; impression-based, device-local, shared transiently with the viewer's ranker; identical section on search), what else is admitted, Reset, and the sheet's own '?' (The filter dialog — names the settings default). Applies live. Everything off is allowed: the feed's empty state answers, not the chip.

COMMENTS · The reply composer

The comment box in the thread is an ENTRY, not a composer: tapping it opens the same full-focus flow, pre-targeted, parent pinned. Two steps — words, then the seal. A comment is TEXT PLUS OPTIONAL MEDIA (comment.md; text required) — deliberately asymmetric to the post's words-XOR-media body, because an answer is words first; '+ Add pictures' rides the writing step, and COMMENTS HAVE NO PICK STAGE (ruled 2026-08-31): it opens the platform's own picker — Android's photo-picker sheet, the browser's file dialog on web — never the post wizard's grid; the web board adds the drop-anywhere path. Comment pictures never crop, so they upload at pick; descriptions ride the signed act (detached from the upload — no race, nothing gates) and are entered from the describe counter. The reply's stance on its parent (+0.10 / +0.10 default) is DISCLOSED on the seal and adjustable on the full two-axis pad: 'Replying also signs where you stand on the post it answers.' Topics and citations can join a comment from its seal, each row raising the count. COMMENT VIDEO (jakob 2026-09-02): a comment's media grammar is the post's at comment caps — four pictures OR one video with its cover, never both kinds. Entry is unchanged (the platform picker; a video pick lands in the video state), there is still no pick stage and no crop, and the cover row is ComposeCover's inlined at comment scale, because the comment composer is one screen and has no stage to give it. Caps as facts: a picture 10 MiB (10 per post, 4 per comment), a video 100 MiB in a post and 50 MiB in a comment, a cover 10 MiB. A FILE THE SURFACE REFUSES — over its cap, or a format nothing here reads — is refused WHERE IT WAS OFFERED, a line in the composer's media row: never a dialog, never a snackbar. The line names the cap it broke, and that is the only place a cap is named. Its one way out is Remove it — never Retry, which cannot make a file smaller or a format readable. Round 2 (jakob, same day): A VIDEO TAKES ONE DESCRIPTION for the whole clip and its cover takes none — the counter reads 'Describe the video · 0 of 1 described' and opens the same describe sheet. THE ADD LABEL FOLLOWS THE STATE: empty reads '+ Add pictures or a video', with pictures '+ Add pictures · n of 4' (the video is out — the grammar is exclusive), with a video no add control at all. WEB TAKES THE VIDEO BOARD 1:1 (file dialog + the drop path; no web board, the avatar blessing's form) and the drop hint grows to 'pictures or a video'. SCREENS WRITE MB while the caps are enforced in MiB — 50 MiB is 52.4 MB, so the readable number under-promises and never refuses a file the product would take. Boards: write (words) · pictures attached · pictures on the web · a video and its cover · files refused · the pad · what you sign.

THE POST SCORE’S DRILL-DOWN (jakob 2026-09-11, backlog item 13). Four levels — the paths, one path, one step, the records behind it — each carrying a small cover of the post it came from. The register is paths and people, never a chart: a bar would turn a reader’s own connections into a statistic about the post. Level one shows the strongest handful and a quiet row that unfolds the rest in place (never a second page), and that row carries what they add, so the drawn figures still sum to the score. The fifth board is the same screen for a post whose paths have all aged out.
